description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as described in the paper “SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into One Separator.” The x-axis represents “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 250,000 seconds, with tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents “Loss,” also on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The “Vanilla” model is depicted by a solid purple line with circular markers, which begins at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreases to a steady value near 2.60 after about 100,000 seconds. The “SepLLM” model is shown by a solid red line with circular markers, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to a steady value near 2.60 after about 100,000 seconds. A green dashed line with arrowheads indicates a 1.26x scaling factor, suggesting that the SepLLM model achieves a comparable loss level to the Vanilla model at a significantly shorter training time, as highlighted by the dashed box enclosing the region from approximately 150,000 to 250,000 seconds.
